name: typing-indicator
title: Typing indicator
description: Who is writing right now, in words and three pulsing dots, handling one, two or many people and speaking up politely at most once every few seconds.
docs: Pass people as the list of names writing right now; the sentence follows it: Anna is typing, Anna and Tom are typing, Anna, Tom and 2 others are typing. max is how many names are spelled out (default 2) and one person too many is always named, so and 1 other never appears. label is the activity after is or are (default typing, or replying, or recording a voice message). With nobody writing the line fades out and keeps its height, so the thread above never jumps. The drawn line changes at once; the spoken copy is a polite status that waits announceEvery milliseconds (default 4000) between announcements. labels translates is, are, and and others.
